ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High dominance of low-intensity pixels (approximate 0-40 grayscale value) with localized high-intensity peaks (approximate 210-255 grayscale value) in a ratio of roughly 18:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The surface is a contiguous low-intensity dark field; high-intensity white blobs are localized at both distal tips and as discrete, scattered point-clusters across the medial and lateral lobe surfaces.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 135 degrees and a vertical depth of 12% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left trailing edge exhibits a low-amplitude, smooth profile; the right trailing edge exhibits distinct, higher-frequency serrations with one macro-indentation near the distal third.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curve originating from the median notch and sweeping towards the anterior, terminating in sharp, upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct vertical high-contrast linear disruption is mapped to the mid-left lobe; several faint, sub-horizontal linear pixel disruptions are visible on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant vertical white linear scar on the left lobe; dense high-contrast nodular clusters at both distal tips consistent with barnacle colonization or prior attachment sites.
other_distinctive_markers: A pronounced, sharp triangular indentation on the trailing edge of the right fluke lobe, distal to the center.
